title: agent-definition — UPSTREAM BASE v2 (authored by Anthropic/Claude Code, not by IS)
description: The v2 upstream projection of the agent-definition contract: the YAML frontmatter shape of a subagent file (agents/*.md) owned by Claude Code. THIS FILE IS A REGENERATION OF THE CAPTURED PROJECTION (DR-062 § 5.1) — it encodes ONLY what the upstream documents (documented fields only, upstream requiredness, upstream wire forms), never an IS-specific rule. IS-specific required fields and constraints live in is-overlay/agent-definition.v2.json. Per DR-062 the v2 base adopts the Class-1 finding of the agent-definition deep capture (059 #1: the 11 unmodeled documented fields — background, disallowedTools, effort, hooks, initialPrompt, isolation, maxTurns, mcpServers, memory, permissionMode, skills — with the projection's types, enums, and per-field requiredness) and the two Class-2 widenings (059 #3: `tools` accepts the documented comma-separated string AND the array form — the array-only narrowing was an IS projection choice and is relocated to the overlay; 059 #4: `model` admits the documented full-model-ID latitude alongside the alias enum + `inherit` — the closed-enum narrowing relocates to the overlay). The Class-3 relocations REMOVE two v1-base encodings with no documented machine-readable provenance: the structural kebab pattern + 64-char cap on `name` (upstream documents 'lowercase letters and hyphens' in PROSE only — 059 #5) and the kernel-only `metadata` extension object (059 #2) — both now live in the overlay. The Class-4 sample-only tolerance is NOT adopted (059 #6: the official sample's `color: magenta` is outside the documented 8-value enum — documented-vs-observed provenance rule). Upstream requiredness: 'Only `name` and `description` are required.' ⇒ required:[name, description].
$comment: PROVENANCE (v2 — DR-062). REGENERATION SOURCE: intent-eval-lab specs/_vendor/upstream/agent-definition/projection.json (projection_version spec-projection/v1, spec_version unversioned-2026-06-12, sha256 7ff25f146d3462ee1d99ec6c0c482df899fad1d617552cb09e3594034e852a56) — per DR-062 § 5.1 the projection is the regeneration source for this base, not a reference. Adjudication: 062-AT-DECR-tier3-reconciliation-authoring-v2-bases-2026-06-12 (acting-CTO ruling; agent-definition rows: C1 = 059 #1, C2 = 059 #3/#4, C3 = 059 #2/#5, C4 = 059 #6 NOT adopted). Authority: code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents § 'Supported frontmatter fields' (the field table); platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/agent-skills/best-practices. VERBATIM upstream facts encoded here, per the projection's fields table: (1) 'Only name and description are required' (projection name_description_only_required: true) ⇒ required:[name, description]. (2) name = string, 'Unique identifier using lowercase letters and hyphens' — kebab-case is PROSE ONLY (projection name_lowercase_hyphens_prose: true), so the v2 base types name as a bare string; the structural pattern + cap are the OVERLAY's (DR-062 C3, 059 #5). (3) description = string, 'When Claude should delegate to this subagent'. (4) tools = the documented comma-separated string (projection tools_wire_form_in_example: comma-separated-string) OR the array form the samples exercise (projection samples.tools_wire_forms_observed: [comma-separated-string, flow-array]; DR-062 C2 row 059 #3 adjudicates the base accepts BOTH); 'Inherits all tools if omitted' (projection tools_inherit_all_if_omitted: true). (5) disallowedTools = string — 'Tools to deny, removed from inherited or specified list'; the doc example wire form is the comma-separated string ('disallowedTools: Write, Edit'); no array latitude is documented or adjudicated for this field. (6) model = bare string — documented aliases {sonnet, opus, haiku, fable} (projection model_aliases_documented) + 'a full model ID (for example, claude-opus-4-8)' (projection model_full_id_latitude: true) + 'inherit' (projection model_inherit_documented: true; defaults to inherit) ⇒ the base CANNOT enumerate a closed set (DR-062 C2, 059 #4); the IS alias-enum narrowing is the overlay's. (7) permissionMode = enum {default, acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions, plan} (projection enum). (8) maxTurns = 'Maximum number of agentic turns before the subagent stops' — an integer turn count; the non-negative floor encodes the count's natural domain (the same encoding hook-config's timeout carries), no documented ceiling. (9) skills = the documented YAML array of skill names ('Skills to preload into the subagent's context at startup'; the doc example is a block sequence of strings). (10) mcpServers = array — 'Each entry is either a server name referencing an already-configured server (e.g., "slack") or an inline definition with the server name as key and a full MCP server config as value' ⇒ entries are string|object, so the base mirrors the projection's bare array (no single documented item schema; inventing one would exceed the documented surface). (11) hooks = object — 'Lifecycle hooks scoped to this subagent', the inline hooks mapping (event → matchers/handlers). (12) memory = enum {user, project, local} (projection enum). (13) background = boolean — 'Set to true to always run this subagent as a background task. Default: false' (projection set_to_value: true). (14) effort = enum {low, medium, high, xhigh, max} (projection enum). (15) isolation = enum [worktree] — 'Set to worktree to run the subagent in a temporary git worktree'; worktree is the ONLY documented value (projection set_to_value: worktree). (16) color = enum {red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, pink, cyan} — exactly the documented 8 values; the official sample's `color: magenta` is OBSERVED-ONLY and NOT adopted (DR-062 C4, 059 #6). (17) initialPrompt = string — 'Auto-submitted as the first user turn when this agent runs as the main session agent'. NOTE: the base intentionally does NOT cap description length — the universal disclosureMarkers fold (v2: 1024) is the operative IS cap. NOTE: the kernel-only `metadata` extension object moved to the overlay per DR-062 Class 3 (059 #2 — documented fields only in the base).
